Routines

Ask once. It keeps working after everyone logs off.

Say what you want and when. Nema runs it in the cloud and posts the result in the channel.

A routine is a sentence, not a form

Every Friday, pull the open invoices and post the total here. That is the whole setup. Nema confirms the schedule in plain words and it runs from then on. Reminders work the same way, in your own timezone.

  1. Say what and whenEvery Friday, post the open invoices here.
  2. Nema confirms itThe schedule, in plain words, in your timezone.
  3. It runs in the cloudOn time, whether or not anyone is online.
  4. The result lands in the channelA new message each run, in its own conversation.
  5. Pause or cancel any timeFrom App Home. /nema routines lists them.

Nothing runs on anyone's laptop

Routines fire while you sleep, travel or sit in meetings. Each run posts a new message in the channel, in its own conversation.

#ops13
  1. Theo Adler3:40 PM

    @Nema every Friday, pull the open vendor invoices from Gmail and post the total here.

  2. NemaAPP3:40 PM

    Set. Runs Fridays at 9:00 in your timezone, in the cloud, and posts a new message here each time.

  3. NemaAPPFri 9:00 AM

    14 open invoices, 62,300 in total. Three are past due; the largest is Northwind at 18,000, due 12 days ago. Full list in the thread.

See everything, stop anything

App Home lists the routines you created, with their schedule. Pause, resume or cancel from there, or type /nema routines for the workspace's list.

Safe when nobody is watching

If a routine wants to make a risky write, it stops before doing it and asks whoever set it, in Slack.
